scope: Twelve newly discovered source repositories, outside the 962 repositories already present in the discovery ledgers, for the five capability domains that still had no featured method after Q8 batches 1-3: Audio, Business, Career, Science, Robotics/IoT.
method: GitHub code search (filename:SKILL.md plus domain terms) for original, focused, domain-native sources; excluded repositories already in registry/discovery and obvious mega-aggregators/mirrors. Each lead's HEAD commit was pinned with git ls-remote and shallow-fetched; the representative SKILL.md path, package git tree SHA, SKILL.md blob SHA, and controlling license file were recorded at that exact commit.
status: DISCOVERY LEADS ONLY. No candidate here is graded, promoted, qualified, security-scanned or counted as eligible. License guesses are from the first lines of the license file and must be confirmed against full text before any copying. HEAD pins are mutable baselines for a future bounded review, not governed pins.
exclusions: Excluded during search: mega-aggregator and mirror repositories (e.g. '14,855+ skills', 'periodically refreshed mirror of ...'), which inflate counts without clean first-party authorship.
next: Bounded exact-version review of the strongest 1-2 leads per domain: pin a governed revision, read full packages, confirm license text, run the pinned static scan, and qualify against the 10-dimension rubric. Deduplicate K-Dense-AI/scientific-agents and MATLAB internally before counting.

records.value_and_cautions: Ableton Live production workflows (mastering prep, arrangement). Domain-native; focused single-tool source.
Room EQ Wizard (REW) acoustics measurement via MCP + skill. Real acoustics-engineering tool; needs the REW app.
Agentic music-production skills (mastering, mixing). Independent author; 21 skills.
rerun.io multimodal robotics/CV visualization (URDF, docs). Established company; Apache-2.0/MIT dual.
Read-only MCP for ROS2/DDS: inspect a running robot's topics. Focused, read-only safety posture worth checking.
Physical-AI skills for coding agents (navigation, ROS2), field-tested claim. 29 skills; verify embodiment assumptions.
Cellular Agriculture AI Library. Niche scientific domain; check protocol/authority boundaries and any wet-lab safety framing.
Official MATLAB agentic toolkit (signal processing, statistics, control). BSD-style MathWorks license; many skills require a licensed MATLAB.
503 expert-profile science skills (acoustics, physics, stats). Large; likely heavy overlap and variable quality — sample before trusting.
Business-plan engine (unit economics, demand forecasting, pricing). 137 skills; check for region-specific assumptions and pricing-advice caveats.
Neurodivergence-aware resume/cover-letter skill. Single focused package; check fabrication guards and any certification-brand claims.
Open-source job-search skill ('stop applying to ghost jobs'): searches and matches postings. Check egress to job boards and any account/scraping terms.

qualified_by: registry/discovery/q8-reference-only-qualification-batch4-widened-20261104.json (2026-11-04): one representative package per source reviewed; 5 Valuable References (one per previously-unfeatured domain), 7 kept in research including a held resume method.
